scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @opsgraph/api" "npm run dev -w @opsgraph/web"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n srv,app "npm run services:dev" "npm run dev"
scripts.services:dev: concurrently -n gw,auth,pay,ord,notif,traf "npm run dev -w @opsgraph/api-gateway" "npm run dev -w @opsgraph/auth-service" "npm run dev -w @opsgraph/payments-api" "npm run dev -w @opsgraph/orders-api" "npm run dev -w @opsgraph/notifications-service" "npm run dev -w @opsgraph/traffic-generator"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @opsgraph/shared && npm run build -w @opsgraph/api && npm run build -w @opsgraph/web
scripts.clean: tsx -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const p of ['apps/api/dist', 'packages/shared/dist', 'apps/web/.next']) rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }); console.log('Cleaned build artifacts');"
scripts.setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate
